review: 702.55b-1: dropped the still_creature variant, which changed a fact without changing the outcome (both fire) and duplicates 702.55c-1.

scenarios.title: A haunt permanent that dies is exiled haunting a target creature

setup.notes: Blind Hunter is a 2/2 flyer with haunt.

decisions: A casts Shock targeting A's own Blind Hunter, tapping Mountain. Both players pass; Shock resolves.
If Blind Hunter dies, its haunt trigger targets B's Grizzly Bears. Both players pass; the trigger resolves.

variants.label: dies
variants.expected: Blind Hunter takes 2 damage and dies. Its haunt trigger fires and resolves: Blind Hunter moves from A's graveyard to exile, haunting Grizzly Bears.

variants.label: survives
variants.expected: Blind Hunter survives with 2 damage; no haunt trigger fires and nothing is exiled.

scenarios.title: A haunt spell is exiled haunting a creature only if it goes to the graveyard during resolution

setup.notes: Cry of Contrition is a sorcery with haunt: target player discards a card.

decisions: A casts Cry of Contrition targeting player B, tapping Swamp.
B passes priority; Cry of Contrition resolves and B discards Forest.
When Cry of Contrition is put into the graveyard during its resolution, its haunt trigger targets Grizzly Bears; both players pass and it resolves.

variants.label: resolves
variants.expected: B discards Forest. Cry of Contrition moves to exile, haunting Grizzly Bears.

variants.label: countered
variants.delta: B instead responds by casting Counterspell on Cry of Contrition, tapping two Islands.
variants.expected: Cry of Contrition is countered and stays in A's graveyard. No haunt trigger fires, and B discards nothing.

scenarios.title: A card haunts the targeted object even when it is no longer a creature

setup.notes: Blind Hunter in exile haunts B's Grizzly Bears. Imprisoned in the Moon turns Grizzly Bears into a colorless land that is no longer a creature.

decisions: A casts Vindicate targeting the enchanted Grizzly Bears, tapping Plains, Plains and Swamp. Both players pass; Vindicate resolves.
If Blind Hunter's trigger fires, A targets player B. Both players pass; the trigger resolves.

variants.label: no_longer_creature
variants.expected: The enchanted permanent is destroyed. Blind Hunter's trigger fires: B loses 2 life (18) and A gains 2 life (22).

variants.label: other_permanent
variants.expected: Runeclaw Bear is destroyed. Blind Hunter does not trigger because the haunted permanent did not die; life totals stay 20 and 20.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge's haunt trigger matches Creature.HauntedBy, so it may not fire when the haunted card is a non-creature land when it dies. The rules text says it does.

scenarios.title: A haunting card's trigger can fire from exile when the haunted creature dies

setup.notes: Blind Hunter in exile haunts B's Grizzly Bears. Its text: when the creature it haunts dies, target player loses 2 life and you gain 2 life.

decisions: A casts Shock targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping Mountain. Both players pass; Shock resolves.
If Blind Hunter's trigger fires, A targets player B. Both players pass; the trigger resolves.

variants.label: haunted_dies
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears dies. Blind Hunter's trigger fires from exile: B loses 2 life (18) and A gains 2 life (22).

variants.label: other_dies
variants.expected: Runeclaw Bear dies. The haunted creature is unaffected and Blind Hunter does not trigger; life totals stay 20 and 20.
